ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 no-show cancellation fee to the rider's original payment method; remind the driver in-app of the mandatory wait-and-contact steps (I'm Here → 5-minute free wait → ≥1 in-app chat + ≥1 in-app call) before cancelling for no-show.
ruling.reasoning:
Screening: the complaint and driver statement contain no threat, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; dispute type is no_show, so no SAFE escalation arises.

Which clause: the driver cancelled with reason "rider_no_show" (trip_data.cancelled_by = driver), so NS-1/NS-2 apply (NS-0). The $5.00 fee stands only if all four NS-1 conditions hold.

(i) Arrival: driver_arrived at 09:53:15, and GPS at 09:53:30 puts him at 1.435975/103.786154 — approx. 5 m from the pickup point (1.43600/103.786500) — within 200 m. Met.
(ii) Free wait: counted from the later of scheduled pickup time and arrival = 09:53:15; the 5-minute free wait expired at 09:58:15. Cancellation was at 09:59:45, i.e. 1 m 30 s after expiry. Met.
(iii) Contact attempts: before cancelling, the record shows no in-app message and no in-app call (chat_logs is empty; the app_events list holds only booking_confirmed, driver_assigned and driver_arrived; no call record exists). This condition fails outright — the rider's statement that he was never messaged or called is consistent with every system record.
(iv) Continuous presence: GPS shows the vehicle stationary on Woodlands Square from 09:53:30 through 09:59:45 (1.0–2.5 km/h, no vacancy) — presence is established, though the arrival-to-arrival window is covered only by thinned telemetry.

Because NS-1(iii) fails, NS-2 applies: the cancellation fee is voided and the rider is not charged → refund_full of $5.00. NS-2's "driver marked arrival while GPS was not at the pickup point" trigger for flag_account does not apply, since GPS confirms he was at the pickup point; only the contact requirement failed. The rider's own timing claim ("a minute after he cancelled") is not relied on and is immaterial.

Rounding / computation: fee charged = $5.00; NS-2 requires refund of the full fee, so amount = $5.00.00. Precedents: DISP-2026-0211 (no-show cancel with zero contact) supports voiding the fee. TH-2 makes no-show/cancellation system-final at the fixed $5.00.

element_findings.element: NS-1(i) driver arrived at pickup within 200 m
element_findings.reason: Arrival event and GPS place the driver ~5 m from the pickup point (1.43600/103.786500), well within the 200 m radius.

element_findings.element: NS-1(ii) 5-minute free wait elapsed before cancellation
element_findings.reason: Wait counted from the later of scheduled pickup and arrival (09:53:15); cancellation at 09:59:45 is 6 m 30 s later, past 09:58:15.

element_findings.element: NS-1(iii) ≥1 in-app message and ≥1 in-app call before cancelling
basis: app_events list has no call/message events
element_findings.reason: No in-app message and no call appear anywhere in the record before the 09:59:45 cancellation; the driver's statement of a no-show does not substitute for the required contact attempts.

element_findings.element: NS-1(iv) driver remained at pickup throughout
element_findings.reason: Telemetry shows the vehicle stationary (1.0–2.5 km/h) at the same point through cancellation, with no gap in the thinned 30 s samples.
Driver cancelled citing rider no-show, so NS-1/NS-2 (not NS-3) govern the fee.

rejected_claims.reason: The arrival and wait are confirmed, but the statement omits the mandatory pre-cancellation in-app chat message and call; without both, NS-1 fails and the fee is voided under NS-2.
The rider's claim of reaching downstairs 'a minute after he cancelled' is immaterial: even on the driver's timeline the fee fails for want of contact attempts.
